method: Built-in image_gen; original outputs copied unchanged to assets/images/trajes.
notes: Base and attack prompts are summarized below; exact remaining pose prompts preserved in entries.
baseAndAttackSummary: For each original character create its alternate costume in the same fantasy sprite style with transparent alpha. Guardiana de Otoño: copper leaves, burgundy cape, leather, amber staff. Alba Lunar: silver and midnight blue moon armor, lunar sword and shield. Sombra Carmesí: crimson hood/cape, obsidian armor, silver trim, red daggers. Attack edits retain the original attack composition and new outfit.

entries.prompt: Create one production fantasy game sprite. Reference is exact character identity and costume to preserve. New pose: Recoiling backward from a harmless magical hit, feet grounded, shocked expression, weapons lowered but retained, no wounds or blood. Match proportions, clothing details, materials, weapon designs and colors from reference. Full body facing right, centered inside frame with generous margin, no cropped extremities. Clean transparent alpha background, no scene, no text, no checkerboard, no backdrop glow. Same polished stylized fantasy illustration.
